items.title: Submit signed rental contract and deposit proof for new flat
items.quote: Damit wir die neue Miete berücksichtigen können, reichen Sie bitte bis zum 14.07.2026 den unterschriebenen Mietvertrag und den Nachweis über die Kaution ein.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for this submission: 14.07.2026. 2026-07-14 is a Tuesday, a normal working day in Brandenburg, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the benefits decision
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Jobcenter Musterhavel-Fläming, Fläminger Weg 4, 14943 Beispielsruh (Havel), eingehen.
items.computation: Document date (date of posting) is 30.06.2026 (Tuesday). § 37 Abs. 2 Satz 1 SGB X deems a postally sent administrative act delivered on the THIRD day after posting (the letter incorrectly states 'am vierten Tag' - see warning). Counting from 30.06.2026: day 1 = 01.07., day 2 = 02.07., day 3 = 03.07.2026 (Friday) = Bekanntgabe. Since Bekanntgabe is an event, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes the day of the event itself; the one-month period runs from 04.07.2026 and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event (03.07. -> 03.08.). 03.08.2026 is a Monday, not a Brandenburg public holiday, so no further shift is needed. Final deadline: 03.08.2026.

warnings: The letter states that a postally sent decision is deemed delivered 'am vierten Tag' (fourth day) after posting, but the actual statutory rule in § 37 Abs. 2 Satz 1 SGB X (as currently in force) sets this at the THIRD day after posting; this record uses the legally correct three-day rule for the Bekanntgabe date and Widerspruch deadline, which is earlier than what the letter's own (incorrect) wording would imply - please double-check this discrepancy, e.g. with the Jobcenter, before relying on the exact deadline.

The monthly benefit amounts (Regelbedarf, Mehrbedarf, KdU, income deduction) are itemised in the decision; only the resulting monthly total (1.233,96 EUR) was recorded as the amount, per instructions not to list invoice-style line items.
